content: The listed copies of Taqdīm al-ʿAql ʿalā l-Nafs are MS Princeton 319 (1187) ff. 69b-70b (copied in the 10th/16th (?) century) and MS Sipahsālār 2930/6 ff. 118b-121a (undated), which is presented to a Dawlat-i Sayyidiyya-yi Imāmiyya-yi Rażaviyya; none is in MS Majlis 10196.
